screenLevelGaps: REQUISITIONS ARE NOT A REAL ENTITY. The Requisitions tab does not read a requisition table — CandidateDropoffController::getRequisitions (hp_erp .../TalentAcquisition/CandidateDropoffController.php:249) selects from `talent_job_postings`, the exact same table the Job Openings tab renders. There is no raise→approve→publish workflow, no approver, no headcount budget. The spec's 'Job requisition workflow' and 'Manpower budget/headcount master' are entirely absent; the tab is a second rendering of Job Openings.

REQUISITIONS TAB SILENTLY HIDES OLD ROLES. getRequisitions defaults `timePeriod` to 'monthly' (CandidateDropoffController.php:237) and then applies `where('r.created_at','>=',now()->subDays(30))` (line 299). The frontend never sends timePeriod (services/talent/recruitment.ts:218). Any job posting older than 30 days disappears from the Requisitions tab AND from the 'Open Requisitions' KPI.

CUSTOMER SUSPICION PARTLY WRONG — the job-posting form DOES pull from Competency, but the link is severed on save. job-posting-form.tsx:97-116 reads departments from `s_user_jobrole`, :123-149 reads job roles from `s_user_jobrole` (and auto-fills the description from `s_user_jobrole.description` at :156), and :159-179 reads the role's skills from `/jobrole_library/create?formType=skills` which is skillJobroleMap on `s_user_skill_jobrole`. So role data is NOT re-typed. BUT on submit (:237-247) only `title: role?.jobrole` (a STRING) and `skills: selectedSkills.join(', ')` (comma-separated skill NAMES) are posted. talent_job_postings has no jobrole_id and no skill_id (talent_jobpostingcontroller.php:133-149). The `skill_id` returned by jobroleLibraryController.php:178 and the `proficiency_level` column on s_user_skill_jobrole (migration 2025_05_27_120915:18) are both DISCARDED by job-posting-form.tsx:167-173. Result: renaming a job role or re-mapping its skills in Competency never propagates to any open posting, and no posting can be joined back to the role matrix.

INTERVIEW SCORECARDS ARE NOT COMPETENCY-LINKED — customer suspicion CONFIRMED. interview-tools-drawer.tsx:88-91 hardcodes exactly two criteria, `{name:'Technical competency'}` and `{name:'Communication'}`, from two free-typed 1–10 number inputs. There is no template builder, no per-role criteria, no skill_id, no KASBA type, and no link to the job's `skills` string let alone to s_users_skills. feedbackController::storeFeedback (:145-147) validates only `evaluation_criteria.*.name` as a free string. Every candidate for every role in every industry is scored on the same two invented axes.

A HIRED CANDIDATE NEVER BECOMES AN EMPLOYEE. No controller under app/Http/Controllers/talent/ inserts into tbluser (verified by grep). Marking Hired only writes the string 'Hired' to talent_job_applications.status (talent_jobapplicationcontroller.php:463). No onboarding journey is created (OnboardingJourneyController accepts optional application_id/offer_id but nothing in recruitment ever posts one), no s_user_jobrole allocation, no s_skill_matrix rows, no LMS enrolment. The spec's 'New hire's role/job-profile → triggers Competency framework mapping & onboarding learning path' is 100% manual re-entry. With app/Events, app/Listeners and app/Observers absent, there is no mechanism that could do it implicitly either.

THE HIRING DECISION DRAWER IS BROKEN TWICE OVER. (a) Payload mismatch: recruitment.ts:212 posts `{decision:'hired'|'rejected', notes}` but InterviewController::recordDecision (:103-106) validates `'status' => 'required|in:Under Review,Hired,Rejected'` — every submission returns 422 'The status field is required'. (b) ID mismatch: the frontend passes `interview.id` from /interview-details (a talent_interview_schedules row, recruitment-center.tsx:840) but the controller looks it up in TalentEvaluationForm (:117) — even with a correct payload it would 404 'Evaluation form not found'. The 'Hiring decision' action can never succeed.

SUBMITTING INTERVIEW FEEDBACK SILENTLY MARKS THE CANDIDATE HIRED. feedbackController::storeFeedback (:178) sets `talent_job_applications.status = 'Completed'`. use-recruitment.ts:24 maps `value === 'completed'` to stage 'Hired'. An interviewer recording a 'No Hire' recommendation moves that candidate into the Hired kanban column and into the Hired KPI.

OFFER ACCEPTANCE IS UNIMPLEMENTED ANYWHERE. TalentOfferController only ever writes status 'draft'→'sent' (:96,:183) or 'rejected' (:277). No route sets 'accepted'. Consequences: the Offers status filter option 'Accepted' (recruitment-center.tsx:343) never matches; the 'Accepted' StatusBadge (:881) is unreachable; the 'Start onboarding' menu item is gated on `offer.status === 'Accepted'` (:893) so it is dead code; and the KPI 'N accepted' (:357) is permanently 0. Offer-acceptance-rate — an explicit Executive-dashboard metric in the spec — is uncomputable.

JD COMPETENCY ANALYSIS IS COMPUTED THEN THROWN AWAY. job-posting-form.tsx:235 awaits /gemini/analyze-jd, which AnalyzeJDController.php:80-92 uses to extract core_skills, behavioral_traits and per-skill competency_level, and :164-180 even matches them against an ICF competency framework. The result is passed ONLY to `sendJobPostingWebhook` (:251), an external n8n GET at n8n.triz.co.in (recruitment.ts:90). It is never persisted on the posting and never read by the resume screener. Worse, the call is awaited BEFORE the save, so an LLM outage (controller returns 500 at :143) blocks job-posting creation entirely.

AI RESUME SCREENING IGNORES THE ROLE COMPETENCY MATRIX. candidate-application-form.tsx:126-130 builds the JD payload as `core_skills` = the posting's comma-split skill names, `behavioral_traits` hardcoded to ['Problem Solving','Teamwork','Communication'], and `competency_level` = 'Intermediate' for EVERY skill. The real required level lives in s_user_skill_jobrole.proficiency_level and was already fetched by the posting form — it is discarded. The spec's 'Job-role-to-competency matrix → used by AI resume screening to weight candidate fit' is not implemented; the weighting is a constant.

SCREENING OUTPUT IS A DEAD END. talent_screening_results stores skill_gaps and strengths (candidate-application-form.tsx:144-145) and the detail panel renders them (candidate-detail-panel.tsx:326-327), but nothing writes them to s_skill_matrix, nothing seeds an LMS learning path, and nothing carries them into onboarding. 'Skills-to-course mapping (LMS) → powers auto-recommended learning after a TM-identified gap' is absent.

THE INTERVIEWS TAB CAN ONLY EVER SHOW SCHEDULED ROWS. talent_interviewschedulescontroller::index (:56) hardcodes `where('a.status','Scheduled')`. The Interviews status filter's 'Completed' and 'Cancelled' options (recruitment-center.tsx:344) therefore match nothing, and the Status column is a constant. Since storeFeedback flips schedules to 'Completed' (feedbackController.php:180-182), an interview disappears from the list the moment feedback is filed.

CULTURAL FIT IS A HARDCODED CONSTANT. talent_screening_results_controller.php:309 returns `'culturalFitIndex' => 78` literally (and matchedCompetencies/totalRequired = 4/4). candidate-detail-panel.tsx:130 prefers that value, so the Cultural Fit meter reads 78% for every candidate in the system.

THE ENTIRE BULK-ACTION BAR IS INERT. 'Move Stage' (:492), 'Assign Recruiter' (:495), 'Send Email' (:499), 'Add Tag' (:502) and 'More' (:505) have no onClick handlers; the checkbox selection they depend on feeds nothing. The spec's 'Communication template management (auto-emails/SMS at each pipeline stage)' has no implementation at all.

'VIEW FULL PROFILE' RENDERS FICTION. candidate-detail-panel.tsx:355 calls onViewProfile, which mounts TalentProfileView (recruitment-center.tsx:270). talent-profile-view.tsx:48 ignores `profileId` and renders `mockProfileData` from talent-profile-data.ts. Its Goals & Performance, Compensation, Mobility and Succession tabs are all mock — this is the screen's only bridge into the rest of Talent Management and it is fake.

TWO DEAD NAVIGATION TARGETS. (a) 'Add New Job Role' pushes /content/Jobrole-library (job-posting-form.tsx:278) — there is no app/content route in the Next.js app and no rewrite in next.config.mjs; it 404s. (b) 'Start onboarding' pushes /module/talent-management/onboarding/onboarding (recruitment-center.tsx:893) — the content map registers accessLink '/module/talent-management/onboarding' (hooks/content-map-m3.ts:16) and use-sidebar-navigation.ts:155 resolves by EXACT pathname match, so the duplicated segment will not resolve.

DEAD DATA COLUMNS ON THE CANDIDATE MODEL. use-recruitment.ts hardcodes `noticePeriod:'—'` (:109) and `starred:false` (:114). The 'Notice Period' row in the detail panel and the Star icons in the table (:586) and kanban card (:31) can therefore never show anything, and there is no star/shortlist-flag action anywhere. talent_job_applications also has no `source` column (model fillable, talent_jobapplication.php:13-31), so the Source filter dropdown (:414) is permanently empty and the Source table column always prints '—'.

INTERVIEWER SKILL-TAGGING READS THE WRONG TABLE. talent_interviewpanelController::getInterviewers (:71-73) joins `s_user_jobrole.department_id = s_users_skills.department_id` — i.e. it lists every catalogue skill in the interviewer's department, not the interviewer's own measured proficiency from s_skill_matrix. The spec's 'Interview panel pool setup & skill-tagging of interviewers' is decorative; panel members cannot be matched to the competencies being assessed.

A DASHBOARD CALL IS FETCHED AND DISCARDED. `teamOverview` is destructured at recruitment-center.tsx:155 and never referenced in the JSX, so /talent/team-overview is fetched on every load of this screen for nothing (use-recruitment.ts:163).

WHOLE SPEC SECTIONS ARE ABSENT FROM THIS SCREEN: candidate self-service portal (status tracker, slot booking, document upload centre, e-signature offer acceptance, pre-boarding portal), employee internal job board and referral tracking, duplicate-candidate detection, Boolean/AI resume database search, ATS stage configuration (PIPELINE_STAGES is a hardcoded const in recruitment-data.ts:82-89), interview scheduling calendar/video integration, background-verification vendor integration, job-board syndication, and offer-letter approval matrix (TalentOfferController mails the letter immediately on create, :183 — there is no approval step).
